title: Square Format Layouts
slide_intent: Allow optical centering without losing hierarchy because square social formats often need a different balance from posters.
strategic_value: The matched square examples can keep Burger King social posts consistent across short and longer copy.
demonstration: Two cream square layouts center headline, subhead and bottom logo while grid lines show margins and different text widths.
practical_value: Adjust headline and subhead sizes for copy length and move vertical margins to achieve optical centering.

content_islands.name: Short-copy square
content_islands.spec: Center the shorter headline, subhead and logo in the first grid.

content_islands.name: Longer-copy square
content_islands.spec: Use a smaller wider headline in the adjacent grid, preserving proportion and alignment.

ingredient.name: Square social composition
ingredient.role: Keep varied copy balanced within a square.
ingredient.application: Use the established grid; center type if needed, adjust size to copy length and adjust vertical margins for optical centering.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. Guidance is explicitly for Instagram posts; centered type is permitted, not compulsory.

reference_purposes.Application: Two Instagram-style squares compare shorter and longer centered copy.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The text permits centered type when needed, requires proportionate headline/subhead sizing and calls for vertical-margin adjustment for optical centering.
